headline: Google Updates Open Knowledge Format & GSC Social Reporting; 89% of ChatGPT Search Demand Has No Owner

Confirmed Search Updates.what_happened: Google announced version 0.2 of the Open Knowledge Format, introducing five new trust signals.
Confirmed Search Updates.why_it_matters: 知识图谱和实体识别的底层标准更新，直接影响 Google 对信息可信度（E-E-A-T）和实体关系的理解。
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence: Google's official release of Open Knowledge Format v0.2 spec adding 5 trust signals.
Confirmed Search Updates.what_to_do: 研究新版 Open Knowledge Format 规范，优化网站的实体结构化数据和信任信号。

Confirmed Search Updates.what_happened: Google opens Search Console platform properties and social/video search data reporting to everyone worldwide.
Confirmed Search Updates.why_it_matters: 允许站长在 GSC 中直接监测和分析来自社交媒体和视频搜索的流量与曝光数据，提升多渠道 SEO 归因。
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence: Google's global rollout of platform properties and official guide on reading social/video search data.
Confirmed Search Updates.what_to_do: 登录 GSC 检查并配置平台属性，分析社交与视频搜索带来的有机流量。

Technical SEO Experiments.what_happened: Google's John Mueller warns against testing conflicting metadata, advising SEOs to fix conflicts directly.
Technical SEO Experiments.why_it_matters: 明确了 Google 处理冲突元数据（如 conflicting canonicals 或 robots 标签）时的不可预测性，测试无意义。
Technical SEO Experiments.evidence: Public statement by Google's John Mueller on Mastodon/X regarding metadata conflicts.
Technical SEO Experiments.what_to_do: 运行技术 SEO 审计，清理 HTML、HTTP 标头和 XML 站点地图中所有冲突的元数据指令。

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Kevin Indig's study of 1,094 categories shows 89% of AI search demand has no clear brand owner in ChatGPT.
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 揭示了在 ChatGPT/GEO 领域，品牌提及和引用的预测性极低，目前仍是高度碎片化且未被垄断的蓝海。
AI Search / GEO.evidence: Data across 1,094 categories showing only 15.2% of categories have a dominant brand owner in ChatGPT.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: 针对核心分类进行 GEO 优化，抢占尚未被竞品垄断的 AI 搜索引用份额。

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Analysis of Perplexity's live answer stream reveals how it selects web sources, video, and local citations.
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 揭示了 Perplexity 并非直接生成答案，而是通过实时检索流筛选网页，这意味着所有实时查询皆可被优化。
AI Search / GEO.evidence: Analysis of Perplexity's live network stream and API response payloads during query execution.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: 针对 Perplexity 的实时检索流特征，优化页面加载速度、结构化数据和直接回答段落。

Today's Action Items.what_to_do: 登录 GSC 检查并配置平台属性，分析社交与视频搜索带来的有机流量。
运行技术 SEO 审计，清理 HTML、HTTP 标头和 XML 站点地图中所有冲突的元数据指令。
针对核心分类进行 GEO 优化，抢占尚未被竞品垄断的 AI 搜索引用份额。
